description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the distribution of “Stimulus Type” categories used in the referenced study, and it contains 10 slices. The slices are labeled around the ring with percentages: Draft/Other (dark red) at about 26.4%, Press Release (gold/yellow) at 18.7%, External News Article (dark green) at 18.1%, Interview (dark navy) at 8.8%, Organizational Report (purple) at 7.7%, Event Posting (brown) at 6.6%, Organizational Website (light lavender) at 4.9%, Email (light green) at 2.7%, Social Media Post (very small orange sliver) at 1.1%, and one additional very thin slice (a narrow light-colored sliver between the yellow and red segments) whose label/percentage is not fully visible in the cropped image. The chart places the title “Stimulus Type” in the center, uses direct labels with percentages (no separate legend), and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the segments appear arranged roughly from the largest near the top-right through smaller categories around the circle.
